title: No console window from unattended console launches
goal: No Susi code path opens a console window by launching icacls or another console helper unattended. The detached daemon (DETACHED_PROCESS, no console) launched icacls once per credential file in its readiness scan; Windows gave each child a new visible console (CEO, 2026-11-09: 'error 0x800700e8 when launching icacls ... susi-lazy-prime-.../node.key'). Root fix (a): owner-only ACLs are set and read natively through Win32 in the susi-vendor-winapi facade (acl module: SetNamedSecurityInfoW/GetNamedSecurityInfoW, process-token user), so no process is launched; susi-core and susi-error gain a cfg(windows) facade edge (not a pillar edge; winapi already in the pillar closure, ceilings unchanged). The readiness scan renders the native DACL in icacls notation and keeps windows_acl_is_overly_permissive and its unit tests unchanged. Every other unattended console launch on daemon and test paths (tasklist, netstat, taskkill, nvidia-smi, rustc, git, --version probes, cloud CLIs, cell spawns, intent exec_command) goes through one std-only helper, susi_paths::console, which owns CREATE_NO_WINDOW.
acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked over every package this task changes (susi, susi-vendor-winapi, susi-paths, susi-error, susi-core, susi-daemon, susi-config, susi-gawd-swarm, susi-gemi, susi-gemi-models, susi-harness, xtask) with their library tests, the susi and xtask binary tests (the schtasks registration unit tests live in the susi binary, xtask's main in the xtask binary) and the three integration tests: no_console_window (the source guard), installed_windows_entry (the real entry executable) and lean_core_ceilings (the pillar line ceilings, which this task may not raise). One native command, no shell. It passes: a restricted file's DACL is exactly one non-inherited FILE_ALL_ACCESS entry for the process token user; the metrics sink and the bus secret are restricted before any secret is written, and a failure to restrict withholds the secret instead of ignoring it; read_dacl fails with a typed error for a non-allow/deny entry of any type (SACL types included) or an unknown ACL revision; the readiness parser judges every right the formatter can print (composite groups, specific write/delete/ACL bits, Guests, Anonymous) and fails closed on unparseable rights; the readiness scan reports a directory it cannot list, an entry it cannot stat and a scan cut short by the entry budget as findings; and the source guard (a token scan of crate sources including test modules, crate and root integration tests, xtask, fuzz, build.rs and the guard itself) finds no icacls launch and no unattended tasklist/netstat/taskkill/nvidia-smi launch outside susi_paths::console, except susi_core::bounded_cmd::output_within(Command::new(..), ..) written with the full path (proved to apply without_window before it spawns) and the launches recorded as held by other claims.

handoff.2026-11-09 (security review fixes): Successor Claude (Sonnet), same claim and branch, HOLD: no push or merge before independent review. Verified from code, then fixed: (1) the readiness formatter printed composite groups such as (R,W) and specific bits (WD, AD, WDAC, WO, DE, DC) that the literal-substring parser never matched, so BUILTIN\Users with R,W/W,D/WDAC/WO and Guests/Guest/Anonymous read read as clean; the parser now splits every group into tokens, judges each (Everyone/Guests/Anonymous may hold nothing, Users/Authenticated Users read only) and fails closed on unknown tokens or unparseable rights, and the formatter shows an unnamed access bit as U<hex> instead of dropping it. (2) the readiness scan skipped unlistable directories, unreadable entries and metadata errors and ignored the entry budget; each is now a finding (one function for Unix and Windows). (3) acl::read_dacl skipped SACL-only/filter entry types as harmless and never checked the ACL revision; any type other than allow/deny now fails with UnsupportedAce and any revision other than 2/4 fails with InvalidData (the AceClass table is deleted). Inherit-only entries are listed, never dropped (over-report only). (4) bus_secret and the error-log sink ignored a failed restrict_to_current_user and wrote the secret first; both restrict the empty file they just created before writing, and on failure bus_secret returns an empty (never matching) key while the sink removes only its own empty file and returns the error. No path is deleted that this call did not create. (5) susi-gawd-swarm is back at its 20,673-line ceiling (cancel_propagate.rs net -3); no ceiling changed. (6) tests/no_console_window.rs is a token scan: comments, raw/byte strings, path-prefixed names, split Command :: new, turbofish, join("icacls.exe") arguments are caught; aliases of Command, unbalanced or unterminated input are violations; unreadable files fail loudly; no file is exempt, including the guard. The only accepted wrapper is the full path susi_core::bounded_cmd::output_within(Command::new(..)<builder calls>, ..), with a test proving that function applies without_window before it spawns. Terminal calls inside the argument, other arguments, shorter paths and look-alike names are direct launches. (7) accept.cmd covers every changed package, the susi and xtask binaries and the lean_core_ceilings and installed_windows_entry tests. (8) tests/installed_windows_entry.rs uses without_window. Integration dependency, stated honestly: tests/gmcp_requirements.rs (5 taskkill) and xtask/src/bin/local-workflow.rs (1 tasklist) are still launched directly on this branch, and tests/workflow_publication.rs still writes the flag value (1); their holders' branches (dot-gmcp-cleanup, dot-reuse, wintests) carry the fixes, and the three HELD tables in the guard must be empty in the combined tree. They are not erased here.
